Independent product↗

Currency Intelligence

A calm market workspace for reference rates, currency conversion, watchlists and local alerts, built around clarity rather than trading noise.

The challenge

People need a clear way to read rates, especially for Naira pairs, without the noise of a trading platform.

The approach

One focused workspace for conversion, markets, context, watchlists, insights, alerts and settings.

The result

A self-built reference tool with no account required; watchlists and alerts stay on the device.

03
Client build · Live↗

Luxe Vita Store

A wholesale catalogue that lets customers browse products, collect quantities and send one organised enquiry instead of a thread of scattered messages.

The challenge

Wholesale buyers often negotiate orders through WhatsApp, but product details and quantities can become scattered across several messages.

What I built

A catalogue that lets customers collect products and quantities across different categories before sending the complete request to the seller in one prepared WhatsApp message.

Why it helps

The seller receives a clearer enquiry from the start, while customers get an easier way to organise what they want to buy.

A food-scanning experience that turns a health score into understandable context and a practical recipe someone can make at home.

11
Independent product↗

Drayline Logistics

A logistics concept with a departure board, shipment tracking and a rate estimator that makes the service useful before an enquiry begins.

The challenge

Many logistics websites simply list their services. I wanted this one to feel useful as soon as it opens, with information that looks and behaves like part of an active operation.

What I built

A live-style departure board, a shipment-tracking experience, and a simple rate estimator that help visitors explore the service before making an enquiry.

Why it helps

The website gives potential customers more reasons to interact, understand the service, and take the next step.
